exposure: Use of tocolysis during external cephalic version (ECV) attempts
outcome: National practices of ECV in French maternity units
Association of tocolysis with ECV attempt
Specific tocolytic drugs used (intravenous atosiban, intravenous salbutamol, oral nifedipine)
cohort: 150 (29%) French maternity units that responded to an online survey distributed to all French maternities.
finding: 52.4% of the French maternity units surveyed used tocolysis for the ECECV attempt, although it is systematically recommended, and the choice of tocolytic drug (e.g., atosiban, salbutamol, nifedipine) differed according to the maternity units' level.
